label: Fertility collapsing among people in their twenties and thirties
description: A widespread decrease in fertility rates among young adults who cannot get pregnant, which he calls a depopulation, and he is told he has said enough about it for the day. American fertility rates have been falling since 2007, so only a change in fecundity rather than in births would distinguish this.

label: Revival and a window of worship in Iran, Yemen and Afghanistan
description: A great revival in Iran and the surrounding areas with a window of freedom of worship, people who have to be dethroned, and a shaking coming to Yemen and Afghanistan, on the same pattern he applies to North Korea. The head of the snake being eliminated refers to the strikes then in the news.
aliases: a revival break out in Iran

label: Iranian infrastructure crippled back decades
description: Iranian infrastructure very crippled and set back by decades, to the stone age, with electricity and oil affected, while a major revival comes there as the country is distracted. The June 2025 strikes had already happened and their damage was being reported when this was given.
aliases: very crippled back set back by decades

label: Petrol above nine dollars, averaging eight coast to coast
description: A ticker showing oil at $200 a barrel, petrol going above $9 and averaging about $8 a gallon from coast to coast, sustained several weeks which he reads from the sun setting repeatedly in the vision. The record American average is just over five dollars, set in June 2022, so this requires a near doubling of the all-time high.
aliases: the price of gas going above $9

label: The black horse rides the east coast, South America and Africa
description: A black horse carrying a sickle, which he notes does not match scripture, riding down the east coast through Virginia to Florida, then South America, then Africa, but not Asia or the Middle East. He flags himself that the sickle belongs to a different horse, which is a rare admission that a vision did not match the text.
aliases: The black horse, this black horse is about to ride
I didn't see him go through Asia

label: A full moon over New York, and an instruction to watch the moon
description: A full moon coming up over New York with an instruction to watch the moon, given alongside Cuba, Russia and war cabinet meetings whose content he says it is not smart to repeat. No month is given and there are twelve or thirteen full moons a year.
aliases: it was over uh New York

label: Named church targets and a Denver shooter in tactical gear
description: A man in military garb with a bulletproof vest and ballistic helmet walking into a crowd in Denver and firing an AR-15, alongside a standing list of church targets: a mega preacher in Texas, a preacher in Tampa, one in North Carolina, one in Minnesota, and two named American ministers he asks prayer for. Pipe bombs at churches in Europe and France appear in the same session. He names states and cities but no church.
aliases: mowing people down with an AR-15
certain mega churches that were targets
pray for security in your churches

label: A great volcano going off in Hawaii
description: A great volcano going off again in Hawaii, described as big, seen in a rapid sequence with the California, Japan and British Columbia shakings. Kilauea has erupted repeatedly through this period, so only an unusually destructive event would count.
aliases: a great volcano going off in Hawaii

label: Every ATM at one bank going black in a cyber attack
description: All the ATMs at a particular bank completely black in a cyber attack with people panicking because they cannot withdraw, aimed at the economy. He does not name the bank here, though he names Bank of America in prayer four days later.
aliases: all the ATMs at the certain bank were completely black
trying to get their money out

label: Cyber attacks on aircraft
description: Cyber attacks coming on planes as well as on the grid, connected to aircraft behaving strangely, landing wrong and flipping upside down, with the dragon and Iran seen behind it. The incidents he cites already had published causes.
aliases: I saw cyber attacks on planes
a lot of uneasiness about flying

label: Crypto gets regulation and a foundation, then becomes part of the beast system
description: Crypto and the new digital money described as the wild west now, with regulations and a foundation coming, and this becoming part of the beast system in the future. Stablecoin legislation was already moving through Congress when this was given.
aliases: it's like the wild west right now
there will be regulations and foundation
part of the B system in the future

label: The great betrayal has not happened yet and is still coming
description: Asked why the great betrayal from the World War II video has not happened, he answers that it is still coming, and describes his visions as layers of an onion covering different scenarios rather than one timeline. Recorded as a claim in its own right because still coming with no date is the mechanism by which an unfulfilled word stays open indefinitely.

label: Biological material trucked out of the struck Iranian mountain
description: Biological material in big fifty gallon drums taken out of the Iranian mountain that was struck and loaded into a truck, which he says he saw on the Saturday before the strike and knows the destination of but will not say. The withheld destination removes the checkable part; the priority question is whether the vision predates the strike.
aliases: taking biological things out of that mountain
I can tell you where they put them to
